Initial commit: Swiss Innovation Ecosystem Monitor

Add Observable Framework application for monitoring Swiss innovation and
entrepreneurship metrics with international benchmarking.

Key features:
- 5 main monitoring areas (R&D, Entrepreneurship, Innovation, KTT, Sustainability)
- Reusable plot components (line charts, bar charts, sankey diagrams)
- Data loaders for OECD, Eurostat, and Swiss innovation survey data
- Interactive visualizations using Observable Plot and D3

Standardize and clean up data files

1. Fix duplicate rows: remove 3 redundant Innovation Booster rows per year
   and 1 redundant Entrepreneurship Training row per year from
   daten_controlling.txt (data was inflated 4x / 2x in aggregations).

2. Remove dead code: delete df_ip export from data.js — it was never
   imported by any page; draw_fin_plot already uses daten_controlling.

3. Standardize instrument names across all data files and code:
   - "BRIDGE: Proof of Concept" / "BRIDGE: Discovery" → no colon
   - "Innovationsschecks" → "Innovationsscheck" (singular)
   - "Innovationsprojekte mit/ohne UP" → full Umsetzungspartner name

4. Add explicit _de suffix to base language columns:
   - daten_controlling.txt: instrument → instrument_de, label → label_de
   - daten_subcluster.txt: instrument → instrument_de
   - Update draw_fin_plot, drawMiniPlot, df_subcluster_n, df_innovationsart
     to use instrument_de / label_de consistently

Restructure sidebar: remove language labels, restore two-level content grouping

Replace the three language wrapper sections in the pages array with flat
top-level entries. Content groups (Projekte von Forschenden, Results, etc.)
are now proper top-level sections, which Observable Framework processes via
normalizeSection — enabling correct two-level nesting without path="undefined".

Per-page CSS in head() hides non-active language items using href-based
selectors (a[href*="/${l}/"]) that match only cross-language links.
